name: Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc.
summary: Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc., a music entertainment company, develops various content and solutions businesses in Japan. The company is involved in event, pay TV, platform, video production, alliance, entertainment cafe, distribution business. It also offers live music venues, artist management, labels and agents, on-demand, platforms, fan clubs, e-commerce and merchandise. The company was formerly known as Space Shower Networks Inc. and changed its name to Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc. in April 2024. Space Shower Skiyaki Holdings Inc. founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
